summary: Many fixes and enhancements to platform-backed video decoding and encoding: FFmpeg integration, Vulkan Video support on Linux, Apple VideoToolbox (AppleVT) and Windows Media Foundation (WMF) encoder hardening, and selective use of hardware codecs (VPX/VP9) on Windows. There are also fixes for HDR color handling on Wayland, handling odd-width frames, chroma-location settings, and leak/fallback cases so hardware acceleration (Vulkan, NVidia, FFmpeg) works more robustly or falls back safely when a driver or FFmpeg version lacks needed features.
